## Predictors: Parcel and location characteristics 
In this script we calculate parcel charcteristics (area_par, peri_par, shp_par, share_area_foot_par, access_par, ucp_par) and characteristics of the location where the parcel is located (heritage_single, heritage_ensemble, mun_prop, service_quality, center_quality, HP_euro_qm, AR_euro_qm, styp_simple, bplan, brw)

## Input data
- Pre-processed parcel dataset of 2023
- Pre-processed building datasets 2023

Additional data
- Public transport quality 2020
- Public transport quality 2040
- Center quality 2020
- Housing prices and rents in 1km² grid
- Outline and year of zoningplans
- Land reference values
- Listed buildings 
- Listed ensembles
- Basic building dataset of 2023 to derive undergroud car parks
- Basic parcel dataset to derive parcels in property of the city of munich

```{r, include=FALSE}
parcels_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output_2023/parcels_04_final_data_2023.gpkg")
bldg_23_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output_2023/bldg_2023_04_cleaned_2021.gpkg")

heritage_single <- st_read("./data_input/Denkmaldaten/Denkmaldaten_LHM_11-2024.gdb", layer = "DENK_BAUDENKM_POLY")
heritage_ensemble <- st_read("./data_input/Denkmaldaten/Denkmaldaten_LHM_11-2024.gdb", layer = "DENK_BAUENSEMB_POLY")
ucp <- st_read("./data_input/Gebaeude_VA/VAGRUND_GEBAEUDE_AKT_202312.shp")
mun_prop <- st_read("./data_input/Flurstücke/VAGRUND_FLURSTUECKE_DFK_202403.shp")
bplan <- st_read("./data_input/Bebauungspläne/BAUG_UMGRIFF_202312.shp")
brw <- st_read("./data_input/Bodenrichtwerte/Bodenrichtwerte.gpkg", layer = "RICHTWERTE_2022")

service_quality_2020 <- st_read("./data_input/OEPNV_Bedienqualitat/OEPNV_Bedienqualitaet.gdb", layer = "OEPNV_Bedienqualitaet_2020")
service_quality_2040 <- st_read("./data_input/OEPNV_Bedienqualitat/OEPNV_Bedienqualitaet.gdb", layer = "OEPNV_Bedienqualitaet_2040")
center_quality <- st_read("./data_input/Zentrenqualitaet/Zentrenqualitaet.gdb", layer = "Zentrenqualitaet_2020")
prices <- st_read("./data_input/Preise_RWI/rwi_prices_2013_2023.gpkg", layer = "rwi_prices_2023")
```

## Data processing

### Geometric charcteristics of parcels
Calculates parcel size, perimeter of the parcel, building coverage and floorspace per parcel.

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Parcel size
parcels <- parcels_raw %>% 
  mutate(area_par = as.numeric(st_area(.)))

# Shape index: perimeter / (sqrt(pi * area) * 2)
parcels <- parcels %>%
  mutate(peri_par = as.numeric(sf::st_perimeter(geom)),
         shp_par = peri_par / (sqrt(pi * area_par) * 2))

# building coverage
overlap <- st_intersection(parcels, bldg_23_raw) %>% 
  transmute(id_par_merge, 
            overlap_area = as.numeric(st_area(.)), 
            floors_bldg) %>% 
  mutate(floor_area = overlap_area*floors_bldg) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(id_par_merge) %>% 
  summarise(overlap_area = sum(overlap_area), 
            floor_area = sum(floor_area))
  
parcels <- parcels %>% 
  left_join(overlap) %>% 
  mutate(overlap_area = if_else(is.na(overlap_area), 0, overlap_area),
         share_area_foot_par = overlap_area/area_par, 
         share_floorspace_par = floor_area/area_par) %>% 
  select(-overlap_area, -floor_area)
```

### Underground car park
We check whether there is an underground building with use "Garage" existing. 

```{r, include=FALSE}
ucp <- ucp %>% 
  filter(GESCHOSSE == -1 & NUTZUNGSAR == 2301) %>% # Filter auf Tiefgaragen
  st_buffer(dist = -1,
            endCapStyle = "SQUARE", 
            joinStyle = "MITRE")

parcels <- parcels %>%
  mutate(ucp_par = lengths(st_intersects(parcels, ucp)) > 0)
```

### Heritage single assignment
We check whether a listed building intersects the parcel. 

```{r, include=FALSE}
heritage_single <- heritage_single %>% 
  st_buffer(dist = -1,
            endCapStyle = "SQUARE", 
            joinStyle = "MITRE")

parcels <- parcels %>%
  mutate(heritage_single = lengths(st_intersects(parcels, heritage_single)) > 0)
```

### Heritage ensemble assignment
We check whether the parcel intersects an heritage ensemble (polygon). 

```{r, include=FALSE}
heritage_ensemble <- heritage_ensemble %>% 
  st_buffer(dist = -1,
            endCapStyle = "SQUARE", 
            joinStyle = "MITRE")

parcels <- parcels %>%
  mutate(heritage_ensemble = lengths(st_intersects(parcels, heritage_ensemble)) > 0)
```

### Property of the city of munich
We check whether the parcels intersects a parcel which is property of the city of Munich. 

```{r, include=FALSE}
mun_prop <- mun_prop %>% 
  filter(EIGENTUMSA != 0) %>% 
  st_buffer(dist = -1,
            endCapStyle = "SQUARE", 
            joinStyle = "MITRE")

parcels <- parcels %>%
  mutate(mun_prop = lengths(st_intersects(parcels, mun_prop)) > 0)
```

## Prepare data for intersection with additional layers
For several other variables, we link the centroid of each parcel (point on surface) to the polygons of the respective input layer. The value of the linked polygon is added to the parcel.  

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Set CRS of parcels as reference
reference_crs <- st_crs(parcels)

# Transform CRS of service_quality, center_quality, and prices to the CRS of parcels
service_quality_2020 <- st_transform(service_quality_2020, reference_crs)
service_quality_2040 <- st_transform(service_quality_2040, reference_crs)
center_quality <- st_transform(center_quality, reference_crs)
prices <- st_transform(prices, reference_crs)
bplan <- st_transform(bplan, reference_crs)
# bplan_jahr <- st_transform(bplan_jahr, reference_crs)
brw <- st_transform(brw, reference_crs)

# Rename and prepare variables
service_quality_2020 <- service_quality_2020 %>% rename(service_quality_2020 = KAT_DIST_G)
service_quality_2040 <- service_quality_2040 %>% rename(service_quality_2040 = Kat_G)
center_quality <- center_quality %>% rename(center_quality = KAT_DIST_G)
prices <- prices %>% 
  select(HP_euro_qm_zstd, AR_euro_qm_zstd) %>% 
  rename(HP_euro_qm = HP_euro_qm_zstd,
         AR_euro_qm = AR_euro_qm_zstd)

bplan <- bplan %>% 
  filter(EBENE == 72) %>%  #reduce to bplan in force
  transmute(bplan = TRUE)
bplan <- st_zm(bplan, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM")
# bplan_jahr <- bplan_jahr %>% transmute(bplan_jahr = Satzu_J) %>%
#   st_zm()
brw <- brw %>% transmute(brw = BRW) %>% 
  filter("NUTZUNG"  !=  'LW')

# Point on Surface der Polygone in parcels_base berechnen
parcels$label_point <- st_point_on_surface(parcels)
```

### Link service quality
```{r, include=FALSE}
# Check whether the point on surface lies within the polygons in service_quality
intersects_service_quality_2020 <- st_intersects(parcels$label_point, service_quality_2020)
intersects_service_quality_2040 <- st_intersects(parcels$label_point, service_quality_2040)

# Add the ID of service_quality to parcels_base if the point on surface lies within the polygon
parcels$service_quality_2020 <- sapply(intersects_service_quality_2020, function(x) {
  if (length(x) > 0) {
    return(service_quality_2020$service_quality_2020[x[1]])  # Takes the ID of the first matching polygon (if multiple)
  } else {
    return("F")  # If no match is found, insert service quality F
  }
})

parcels$service_quality_2040 <- sapply(intersects_service_quality_2040, function(x) {
  if (length(x) > 0) {
    return(service_quality_2040$service_quality_2040[x[1]])  # Nimmt die ID des ersten (falls mehrere) übereinstimmenden Polygons
  } else {
    return("F")  # Wenn keine Übereinstimmung gefunden wird, Service-Qualität F einfügen
  }
})

# Helper function: convert categorical values (A-F) to numeric values (1-6)
service_level_num <- function(level) {
  levels <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F")
  if (level %in% levels) {
    return(7 - match(level, levels))  # 7 - position inverts the numbering
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

# Convert service quality to numeric values
numeric_2020 <- sapply(parcels$service_quality_2020, service_level_num)
numeric_2040 <- sapply(parcels$service_quality_2040, service_level_num)

# Calculate change
parcels$service_quality_chg <- numeric_2040 - numeric_2020
```

### Link center quality
```{r, include=FALSE}
# Check whether the point on surface lies within the polygons in center_quality
intersects_center_quality <- st_intersects(parcels$label_point, center_quality)

# Add the ID of center_quality to parcels_base if the point on surface lies within the polygon
parcels$center_quality <- sapply(intersects_center_quality, function(x) {
  if (length(x) > 0) {
    return(center_quality$center_quality[x[1]])  # Takes the ID of the first matching polygon (if multiple)
  } else {
    return("F")  # If no match is found, insert center quality F
  }
})
```

### Link price variables
```{r, include=FALSE}
# Check whether the point on surface lies within the polygons in prices
intersects_prices <- st_intersects(parcels$label_point, prices)

# Add prices to parcels_base if the point on surface lies within the polygon
parcels$HP_euro_qm <- sapply(intersects_prices, function(x) {
  if (length(x) > 0) {
    return(prices$HP_euro_qm[x[1]])
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
})

# Identify the indices of parcels with NA values
na_indices <- which(is.na(parcels$HP_euro_qm))

# Check if there are any NA values at all
if (length(na_indices) > 0) {

  # Go through each parcel with an NA value
  for (i in na_indices) {
    ## 1. Create a 500m buffer around the point of the current NA parcel
    buffer_zone <- st_buffer(parcels$label_point$geom[i], dist = 1500)

    ## 2. Find parcels whose points lie within the buffer
    # We use st_intersects, which returns a list, and take the first element.
    intersecting_indices_list <- st_intersects(buffer_zone, parcels$label_point$geom)

    # Check if the list is not empty
    if (length(intersecting_indices_list) > 0 && length(intersecting_indices_list[[1]]) > 0) {
        intersecting_indices <- intersecting_indices_list[[1]]

        ## 3. Exclude the current parcel itself
        neighbour_indices <- setdiff(intersecting_indices, i)

        ## 4. Calculate the mean of neighboring prices
        if (length(neighbour_indices) > 0) {
          neighbour_prices <- parcels$HP_euro_qm[neighbour_indices]

          # Calculate the mean, ignoring any NAs among neighbors
          mean_price <- mean(neighbour_prices, na.rm = TRUE)

          ## 5. Assign the mean (only if it is not NaN – in case all neighbors are NA)
          if (!is.nan(mean_price)) {
            parcels$HP_euro_qm[i] <- mean_price
          }
        }
    }
  }
}

# Check the result
summary(parcels$HP_euro_qm)
sum(is.na(parcels$HP_euro_qm)) # Sollte jetzt 0 sein, es sei denn, einige Parzellen hatten keine Nachbarn mit Preisen

# Add prices to parcels_base if the point on surface lies within the polygon
parcels$AR_euro_qm <- sapply(intersects_prices, function(x) {
  if (length(x) > 0) {
    return(prices$AR_euro_qm[x[1]])
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
})

# Identify the indices of parcels with NA values
na_indices <- which(is.na(parcels$AR_euro_qm))

# Check if there are any NA values at all
if (length(na_indices) > 0) {

 # Go through each parcel with an NA value
  for (i in na_indices) {
    ## 1. Create a 500m buffer around the point of the current NA parcel
    buffer_zone <- st_buffer(parcels$label_point$geom[i], dist = 1500)

    ## 2. Find parcels whose points lie within the buffer
    # We use st_intersects, which returns a list, and take the first element
    intersecting_indices_list <- st_intersects(buffer_zone, parcels$label_point$geom)

    # Check if the list is not empty
    if (length(intersecting_indices_list) > 0 && length(intersecting_indices_list[[1]]) > 0) {
        intersecting_indices <- intersecting_indices_list[[1]]

        ## 3. Exclude the current parcel itself
        neighbour_indices <- setdiff(intersecting_indices, i)

        ## 4. Calculate the mean of neighboring prices
        if (length(neighbour_indices) > 0) {
          neighbour_prices <- parcels$AR_euro_qm[neighbour_indices]

          # Calculate the mean, ignoring any NAs among neighbors
          mean_price <- mean(neighbour_prices, na.rm = TRUE)

          ## 5. Assign the mean (only if it is not NaN – in case all neighbors are NA)
          if (!is.nan(mean_price)) {
            parcels$AR_euro_qm[i] <- mean_price
          }
        }
    }
  }
}

# Check the result
summary(parcels$AR_euro_qm)
sum(is.na(parcels$AR_euro_qm)) # Should now be 0, unless some parcels had no neighbors with prices
```

### Link zoning plan 
```{r, include=FALSE}
# Check if the point on surface lies within the polygons in bplan
intersects_bplan <- st_intersects(parcels$label_point, bplan)

# Add the bplan ID to parcels_base if the point on surface lies within the polygon
parcels$bplan <- sapply(intersects_bplan, function(x) {
  if (length(x) > 0) {
    return(bplan$bplan[x[1]])  # Take the ID of the first matching polygon (if multiple)
  } else {
    return(FALSE)  # If no match is found, insert FALSE
  }
})
```

### Link BRW
```{r, include=FALSE}
# Check if the point on surface lies within the polygons in brw
intersects_brw<- st_intersects(parcels$label_point, brw)

# Add the BRW values to parcels_base if the point on surface lies within the polygon
parcels$brw <- sapply(intersects_brw, function(x) {
  if (length(x) > 0) {
    return(brw$brw[x[1]])
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
})

# Identify the indices of parcels with NA values
na_indices <- which(is.na(parcels$brw))

# Check if there are any NA values at all
if (length(na_indices) > 0) {

  # Loop through each parcel with an NA value
  for (i in na_indices) {
    ## 1. Create a 1500m buffer around the point of the current NA parcel
    buffer_zone <- st_buffer(parcels$label_point$geom[i], dist = 1500)

    ## 2. Find parcels whose points lie within the buffer
    # We use st_intersects, which returns a list, and take the first element
    intersecting_indices_list <- st_intersects(buffer_zone, parcels$label_point$geom)

    # Check if the list is not empty
    if (length(intersecting_indices_list) > 0 && length(intersecting_indices_list[[1]]) > 0) {
        intersecting_indices <- intersecting_indices_list[[1]]

        ## 3. Exclude the current parcel itself
        neighbour_indices <- setdiff(intersecting_indices, i)

        ## 4. Calculate the average of neighbor values
        if (length(neighbour_indices) > 0) {
          neighbour_prices <- parcels$brw[neighbour_indices]

          # Calculate the mean and ignore any NAs among the neighbors
          mean_price <- mean(neighbour_prices, na.rm = TRUE)

          # 5. Assign the mean value (only if it is not NaN – in case all neighbors are NA)
          if (!is.nan(mean_price)) {
            parcels$brw[i] <- mean_price
          }
        }
    }
  }
}
```
